summary.text: Estelle Oliansky is the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election; she advanced from the August 4 Republican primary and faces Democrat Matt Koleszar in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Oliansky ran for an at-large seat on the Plymouth-Canton Community Schools board in 2014, finishing fourth in a field of six for two six-year seats.
According to Ballotpedia, she received an endorsement in that race from then-state Senator Patrick Colbeck.
